title: Project list (laptop, written by a person)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\projects.json (D54, D55, D91): the projects that may have a host made, each with the date Terry approved it, and from v0.12 the platforms each MAY have a host made on, each with the date Terry approved it (D91, Q21). Written by a person, read by the driver and the operator, and never added to by agentspace on its own. It governs only making a host: a project that has a host on a platform in hosts.json is placed on that platform whether the list approves it or not. A missing file lists nothing. Strict like the contract's output schemas: anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). A file in which two entries share a name is not valid, though this schema cannot refuse it. A program before v0.12 refuses an entry holding platforms, so v0.12's programs MUST be installed together (D91); the version stays 0, since an older reader refuses such a file rather than misreading it. See docs/state.md, "The project list".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

name.description: The normalized project name, in the lease contract's form.

approved.description: The date Terry approved the project, as YYYY-MM-DD.

platforms.description: From v0.12 (D91, D101; architect's to confirm, pin P4): the whole list of platforms the project MAY have a host made on, each with the date Terry approved it. When present, linux/arm64 is approved only if it is listed. Absent means linux/arm64 alone, approved on the entry's approved, which is what every entry before v0.12 is. At least one item. Two items with one platform make the file not valid: this schema refuses two equal items, and two items naming linux/arm64, linux/amd64 or windows/amd64, the platforms v0.12 supports (D98), but cannot refuse two naming any other platform, since JSON Schema cannot compare two items' members. A platform agentspace does not support MAY be listed, and approving it has no effect. Written after approved.

approval.description: One platform's approval: the platform, then the date Terry approved it for the project. No other member is allowed.

platform.description: The normalized platform approved, by its form and not from a list (pin P4).

approved.description: The date Terry approved this platform for the project, as YYYY-MM-DD, the form of the entry's approved.

platform.description: A normalized platform, os/arch, as lease-api.md's Platform section normalizes one: lowercase letters and digits on each side of one /, with aarch64 written arm64 and x86_64 or x86-64 written amd64 (pin P1). No variant: no platform agentspace supports has one, and D91's names write the platform's one / as -. The same form as hosts.state.schema.json's platform.
